name: @pi-in-go/pigpen-subagents
description: Go port of pi-subagents: agent and chain definitions and their discovery, agent management, refinement, doctor and guide actions, subagent profiles, the advertised agent catalog, single-agent and chain runs through child pig processes, background runs, the run policy, and the workflow sandbox (an embedded JavaScript interpreter, goja) with the validate action. Running workflows and parallel runs, missions, worktrees, steering and the fleet views are refused (partial)
author: Michael Kinsy
